How to set up an Apple MagSafe Charger
Shop

Setting up an Apple MagSafe Charger is simple. There's no Bluetooth pairing, app installation, or special configuration required.

Connect the charger. Plug the MagSafe Charger's USB-C cable into a compatible USB-C power adapter.

Plug it into a wall outlet. For faster charging, use an appropriately rated USB-C Power Delivery adapter.

Position your iPhone. Place the MagSafe charger against the center of the back of your compatible iPhone.

Check charging. The magnets should align automatically, and a charging indicator will appear on the iPhone screen.

You can leave your iPhone on the charger until you're ready to use it.

Charging speed

According to Apple's setup instructions, charging speed depends on your iPhone, charger generation, and power adapter.
